sentences.en: The restaurant is a pleasant out-of-the-way spot in New York.
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅是纽约一个舒适且偏僻的好去处。

sentences.en: This is a nice restaurant. Thanks for bringing me here.
sentences.zh: 这是一家不错的餐厅。谢谢你带我来。

sentences.en: I can't afford to eat in such an expensive restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我负担不起在这么贵的餐厅吃饭。
